projects.name: DocuMind RAG Assistant
projects.description: Built an internal knowledge-base chatbot that answers employee questions from company documentation. Implemented hybrid retrieval combining dense vector search with BM25 keyword matching. Reduced average query resolution time by 40% compared to manual document search.
highlights: Designed chunking strategy with metadata-aware splitting for PDF and Markdown docs
Deployed on AWS Lambda with API Gateway; handles 500+ queries/day
Achieved 85% user satisfaction in internal beta testing

projects.name: Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Developed a real-time analytics platform for an e-commerce client to monitor sales, inventory, and user behavior. Processed 2M+ events per day with sub-second latency for dashboard updates.
highlights: Architected event-driven pipeline using Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming
Built REST and WebSocket APIs for live dashboard feeds
Optimized PostgreSQL queries reducing report generation time from 45s to 3s

projects.name: HealthTrack Mobile App
projects.description: Co-developed a health-tracking mobile application with 10,000+ downloads. Features include step counting, calorie logging, medication reminders, and weekly health reports.
highlights: Implemented offline-first sync using local SQLite and cloud backup
Integrated push notifications for medication reminders (95% delivery rate)
Published on Google Play Store with 4.5-star average rating
